compute.peak_concurrency_note: An early queue briefly undercounted a non-atomic status record and launched one extra worker. No scientific process was interrupted. The replacement queue counts live processes and treats unreadable records as active.
compute.timing_scope: Individual elapsed wall time and sampled process RSS; overlapping jobs share hardware. These are observations, not a performance guarantee.
